info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Central Cash Handling Management API
info.description: The Central Cash Handling Management API provides functionality for maintaining optimal cash levels within banking operations. This API allows users to update cash handling parameters, ensuring efficient management of central cash resources. Common use cases include enhancing cash distribution strategies and adjusting handling procedures. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and treasury management teams looking to streamline their cash operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of the Central Cash Handling payment details identified by the unique resource identifier RES-100045. It ensures that all updates conform to the business rules applicable to cash handling processes.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the necessary information to update the central cash handling operations. This request body should be structured according to the schema defined in the components section, and must include all required fields to ensure successful processing of the patch request.
